biography:
I am a seasoned leader with extensive experience in developing long-term strategies and driving organizational success. Currently, I serve as the Regional Director of Site Acquisition at Microsoft, where I lead a team of senior professionals in identifying, acquiring, and developing strategic locations for Microsoft's cloud infrastructure across Northern and Central West Europe. My role involves collaborating with global senior executives, shaping policies, and ensuring projects are completed on time and within budget.

Previously, I held key positions at IBM Cloud and Digital Realty, where I managed site selection, acquisition, and engineering teams across EMEA. My accomplishments include significant portfolio growth, successful execution of complex projects, and the development of new strategic partnerships.

I am known for my positive mindset, creativity, and result-driven approach. I have a strong acumen in building and managing teams, fostering company culture, and driving growth and efficiency. My educational background includes an Executive Master of Real Estate from TiasNimbas Business School and a Postgraduate in Real Estate Management from The Hague University of Applied Sciences.

I am actively involved in various strategic planning and improvement teams and have received multiple awards for my performance and contributions. I am passionate about continuous learning and development, having completed numerous leadership and professional training programs.
